source_name: Ministry of Finance — Public announcements / Јавни огласи and Завршени јавни огласи
why_relevant: Non-procurement-law public calls (concessions, selections of service providers, expressions of interest) that still reveal buying intent for financial services; closed-calls page gives outcomes.

source_name: Ministry of Finance archive site — procurement notices and contracts (arhiva.finance.gov.mk)
why_relevant: Legacy MoF site retaining older notices/contracts removed from the current CMS — essential for multi-year vendor and price history of banking/payment contracts.

source_name: Public Revenue Office (Управа за јавни приходи, УЈП)
why_relevant: The tax authority collects revenue through bank channels and buys payment/collection, card and IT services; it publishes its own internal procurement procedure and document repository under /uploads/File/.

source_name: UJP internal procurement procedure document (Процедура за планирање, спроведување и реализација на јавните набавки во УЈП)
why_relevant: Reveals UJP's internal buying workflow, timelines and which unit drafts specifications — useful for timing engagement and for knowing which documents exist and can be FOI-requested.

source_name: Customs Administration of RNM — Public Procurement (Царинска управа, Јавни набавки)
why_relevant: Customs is a major collector of duties via bank/POS channels and publishes procurement plans, notices and concluded contracts plus full tender dossiers (TD PDFs) on its own domain.

source_name: Customs Administration legacy portal — ESJN mirror (old.customs.gov.mk)
why_relevant: Retains older Customs notices/ESJN links that may no longer be on the live site; supports multi-year vendor history.

source_name: Health Insurance Fund of RNM (Фонд за здравствено осигурување, ФЗО) — Јавни набавки
why_relevant: One of the largest extra-budgetary buyers; procures banking, payment-processing and card-related services and hosts procurement PDFs on its own WBStorage file server.

source_name: Pension and Disability Insurance Fund of North Macedonia (ФПИОСМ / ПИОМ) — piom.com.mk
why_relevant: Pays ~600k pensions through commercial banks and buys payment-distribution, card and IT services; publishes annual accounts and board decisions on procurement procedures on its own site. Note the correct domain is piom.com.mk (not fiom.com.mk).

source_name: Ministry of Finance — Treasury sector pages (Трезор) and Treasury reports
why_relevant: Defines the single Treasury account regime, budget-user account opening and payment processing — the institutional context that determines what treasury/payment services the state can and does buy, and who the counterparties are.

source_name: CFCD — Central Financing and Contracting Department, Ministry of Finance
why_relevant: Runs all IPA/EU-funded tenders for the state, including IT and financial-sector modernisation projects; publishes tender calls and contracted projects separately from ESJN, in MK and EN.

source_name: Government of RNM — Public procurement plan (vlada.mk/nabavki)
why_relevant: The General Secretariat's own plan, and a template for how central budget users publish plans; also a pointer to government-level decisions authorising large procurements by ministries in this cell.

source_name: ASPI — Agency for Protection of the Right to Free Access to Public Information (register of information holders)
why_relevant: Authoritative register of every public-information holder with its FOI officer contacts — the legal route to obtain procurement documents that these authorities do not publish (draft specs, contract annexes, price lists).

source_name: Institutional 'List of public-character information' pages (e.g. FZO)
why_relevant: Each authority must list which document classes it holds and publishes; this enumerates the procurement artefacts that exist (plans, decisions, contracts) and is the precise basis for targeted FOI requests.

source_name: uslugi.gov.mk — national institution/services registry
why_relevant: Canonical institution directory with official names, hierarchy and web addresses — the backbone for building and maintaining the actor map of state contracting authorities in this cell.

source_name: Македонска банкарска асоцијација (МБА) — Членови
why_relevant: Enumerates the full banking-sector membership (14 banks, savings houses, KIBS clearing house, Macedonian Credit Bureau) — the canonical actor list of contracting authorities on the demand side for banking/payments tenders.

source_name: МБА — Референтни банки (SKIBOR panel)
why_relevant: Names the reference/panel banks for the SKIBOR benchmark — a short, authoritative list of the systemically important banks that dominate IT and payments spending.

source_name: МАСИТ — Членки на МАСИТ (ICT chamber member directory)
why_relevant: Paginated directory of Macedonian ICT companies with names and websites; the primary way to enumerate the long tail of local IT vendors/integrators that bid on bank and public payments tenders (KIBS AD Skopje is a listed member).

source_name: Биznisregulativa.mk — profile of MASIT (chamber registry entry)
why_relevant: Government-run registry of chambers/associations; useful to enumerate ALL sectoral chambers (not just MASIT) that carry member lists relevant to banking, payments and ICT supply.

source_name: Стопанска комора на Северна Македонија — Финансии / Здружение на финансиски организации
why_relevant: The main national chamber hosts an association of financial organisations and a member base; its finance section names partner banks and financial-sector members, providing another cross-check actor list.

source_name: Централен регистар на РСМ — основен профил на регистриран субјект
why_relevant: The national business registry — authoritative identity resolution (ЕМБС/registration number, legal form, activity code, status) for every bank, PSP and supplier encountered in tender notices; the backbone for entity deduplication.

source_name: Централен регистар — Дистрибутивен систем (bulk data ordering)
why_relevant: The licensed channel for bulk/company-set data from the business registry — the legal route to obtain a supplier/actor master file instead of scraping.

source_name: Централен регистар — Отворени податоци / објави
why_relevant: Open-data section exposing basic registration data and registry publications (status changes, liquidations, insolvency) — early signal on supplier viability and on new PSP/fintech incorporations.

source_name: ЕСЈН — Склучени договори (register of concluded contracts by institution)
why_relevant: Enumerates contracting authorities and, per authority, the awarded suppliers — turns award data into a supplier registry and reveals which vendors serve which public/financial bodies.
